content.content: Did you know that "Call Me Maybe" by Carly Rae Jepsen became the first lead female artist to reach #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart in over two and a half years, marking a significant milestone in her career? The song also sold 20 million copies in record time and remained on the Billboard chart for 36 weeks, solidifying its place in pop culture history.
content.title: Call Me Maybe

alternatives.text: Did you know that "Call Me Maybe" by Carly Rae Jepsen became a viral sensation in 2012 after Justin Bieber and Selena Gomez shared a lip-sync video of the song on social media? The catchy pop tune skyrocketed to the top of the charts worldwide, earning Jepsen a Grammy nomination for Best Pop Solo Performance. The song's infectious chorus and relatable lyrics about mustering up the courage to give someone your number struck a chord with listeners, making it a timeless pop classic that continues to be a favorite for sing-alongs and dance parties.
